messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected from gateways in eu-north-1 (30m window) -- spikes to 18% p50 latency. Auto-escalation to on-call triggered.

pagerduty → @sara: You are on-call (P1).

sara: seeing it. I'm pulling traces now. Which services are throwing 5xx?

chris: gateway proxy is returning 502/504 at the edge. Early signs point to upstream ml-worker timeouts. Example curl from edge:

```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout: ml-worker"}
```

jordan: redis connection errors also increase in the same window for eu-north. Logs show repeated `READONLY` errors from redis-replica-2. Could be a partial outage or network flakiness between proxy and cache.

sara: ok, runbook step 1: confirm upstream capacity. @chris can you `kubectl get pods -n ml eu-north` and paste counts? Also check `ml-worker` pod restarts.

chris: on it.

(chris) output:
```
$ kubectl -n ml get pods -l app=ml-worker,region=eu-north
ml-worker-0   1/1 Running   0    12h
ml-worker-1   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff   5    45m
ml-worker-2   1/1 Running   0    6h
```
`kubectl describe ml-worker-1` shows oom-kill and then crashloop; node reports high memory.

nishant: memory pressure on that node correlates with a kernel OOM event around 15:02 UTC. We're seeing degraded CPU steal on eu-north-node-7. Might be noisy neighbor or bad batch job.

maria: I'm seeing route-level errors in the router trace for traffic from eu-north to ml-worker-1 specifically — high connect latency followed by `ETIMEDOUT`.

sara: triage summary: subset of ml-workers in eu-north experiencing OOM/crashloops, causing upstream timeouts at gateway, and redis Replica 2 is flaky. Customer impact: increased 5xx for eu-north tenants; global fallback is kicking in for some requests but not all. Next actions: 1) scale ml-workers in eu-north (scale up 2 replicas), 2) cordon/evict noisy node, 3) fail traffic for region to eu-west as temporary mitigation if scaling doesn't reduce 5xx.

chris: scaling now: `kubectl -n ml scale deploy/ml-worker --replicas=5 --region=eu-north` -> scaling started. Keeping an eye on pod readiness.

maria: I'll open a network probe to confirm redis connectivity and check if replica promotes incorrectly. Running: `redis-cli -h redis-replica-2.INFO role`

jordan: meanwhile, setting temporary rate limiter on client routes from eu-north to reduce load: `rlctl set route /v1/generate rate 60rps --region eu-north` to alleviate pressure on faulty workers.

sara: good. Also update status page: small group of eu-north users experiencing errors; mitigation in progress. @maria can you draft the status blurb?

maria: status page draft:
"Investigating increased error rate (5xx) impacting inference requests in eu-north. We are scaling workers and applying routing mitigation. No customer data loss. Updates every 15 minutes."

chris: ml-worker scaling finished. New pods becoming Ready. Observing error rate drop from 18% -> 7% in 3 minutes. But redis errors persist for some traffic.

nishant: I've cordoned eu-north-node-7 and drained pods off it to remove noisy neighbor. Node shows multiple large non-critical batch jobs — I've killed the offending job.

maria: redis-replica-2 responded to `INFO` but still shows `sync_in_progress:1` for a bit. Might be replication lag after node shuffle.

sara: acceptable for now. If 5xx falls below 1% and customer-facing errors are minimal, we keep monitoring. If >5% persists for next 10m, we will shift region-level routing to eu-west.

chris: monitoring: 5xx now 3.2% last 1m; tail latency improving.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary deploy started for router fallback policy update. `router-service` config diff: add eu-north -> fallback eu-west with weight 0.4 for new requests.

jordan: re-run health checks on redis cluster and force a replica resync if needed. Commands executed. Replica resync completed, no errors in last 2 mins.

sara: great. Estimating customer impact: mostly non-enterprise tenants in eu-north with retries; a few in-field API calls failed once. No sustained outage. Plan: keep scaled replicas, monitor for 30m, then uncordon node after 1h and watch.

maria: status page updated with draft and note about mitigation.

chris: confirm final metrics: 5xx at 0.9% over 5m, p95 latency stable.

sara: lowering priority of paging. Keeping this thread for runbook notes and handoff. If anything regresses, @sara on-call will re-alert.

jordan: leaving a short post-incident action item: investigate OOM cause on ml-worker-1 (possible memory leak or insufficient requests per pod), and add a node autoscale threshold to avoid noisy-batch eviction.

sara: thanks everyone. Adding to incidents board and assigning follow-ups to @chris (pod OOM root cause), @nishant (node autoscale/eviction policy), @maria (redis HA runbook improvements). :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident archived to incidents/3098765432 after mitigation confirmed."
